notes.text: Primary sport: Capoeira (Garmin MMA label is proxy only).
Post-run Walk activities are intentional HR-recovery checks. Best sample min HR ~105 after ~12 min cool-down.
Day-by-day coaching only — no rigid 7-day microcycles unless requested.
Easiest high-impact levers: sleep after Capoeira, longer cool-downs, one easy session/week, green/yellow hard-day rule.
Capoeira ~2h evening, high max HR, large Body Battery cost; next sleep need elevated.
